audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer still credits Quinn levels 1-2 and calls the rest even; the packet and the audited mirror both give Mordekaiser levels 2 through first item.
audit.why: 49.24% over 331 games with a HARD 7.5/10 rating cannot coexist with a chart that hands Quinn the early game. The mordekaiser-side audit already flipped all seven rows to Skill, Mordekaiser x5, Quinn.
audit.corrected: All seven rows re-proposed as one atomic group in both layers: Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Quinn. Difficulty rating left at 7.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer's phase whys pinned every level to 'Realm of Death's cooldown', including levels 2 and 4-5 where he does not have an ultimate.
audit.why: Realm of Death is not available until 6 (140/120/100s). His level 2-5 pressure is Death's Grasp (16/14/12/10/8s) into isolated Obliterate (8/7/6/5/4s), sustained by Indestructible (12/11/10/9/8s).
audit.corrected: Level 2 and 4-5 whys re-pointed to Death's Grasp and Obliterate with their real cooldowns; the first-item why re-pointed to his AP item plus Realm of Death beating the Youmuu's spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer repeatedly says to 'Q-blind his trade window'. Blinding Assault blinds basic attacks; Mordekaiser's damage is Obliterate and Darkness Rise, neither of which the blind touches. The content layer already states this correctly; the full layer contradicts it.
audit.why: Riot text for Blinding Assault hinders vision; Obliterate is a spell and Darkness Rise is an aura. The blind cannot reduce either.
audit.corrected: Full layer re-pointed: the blind is not the answer here, Vault (E, 12/11/10/9/8s) is, held to break Death's Grasp rather than spent as an engage. Realm of Death numbers added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer never mentions Grievous Wounds; only the full layer's report and late breakdown do.
audit.why: Indestructible converts damage dealt and taken into a shield he can consume as a heal, on 12/11/10/9/8s — Quinn's chip pattern is exactly what it eats.
audit.corrected: Executioner's Calling timing written into the mid text with Indestructible's cooldown.

edits.before: Vault resets the spacing whenever he closes. Only take the trade when Mordekaiser's Realm of Death is down.
edits.after: Vault breaks his Death's Grasp pull — hold it for that, not to engage. Obliterate is back up every 8s at rank 1.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Realm of Death's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He turns every Death's Grasp into isolated Obliterate while Indestructible heals your chip back. Buy Executioner's and farm safe.

edits.before: Youmuu's Ghostblade is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Realm of Death's cooldown.
edits.after: Youmuu's is your spike, but his AP item plus Realm of Death wins any duel he forces. Poke, never commit.

edits.before: Harass Mordekaiser with marked autos, Q-blind his trade window, and vault out the instant he commits.
edits.after: Harass with Harrier autos at range, and Vault out the instant Death's Grasp lands — the blind won't help.

edits.before: Harass Mordekaiser with marked autos, Q-blind his trade window, and vault out the instant he commits.
edits.after: Merc Treads and Spectre's Cowl blunt Realm of Death; Executioner's cuts Indestructible's heal.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Death's Grasp pulls you into isolated Obliterate — his whole trade.

edits.before: Vaulting INTO the fight to feel like an assassin — Vault is your spacing reset, not an engage.
edits.after: Inside Realm of Death he steals your stats and there is nowhere to Vault to — enter healthy or not at all.

edits.before: Track Mordekaiser's Realm of Death: His 1v1 realm. Survive it with MR. When it is down — Vault-blind + R him.
edits.after: Track Realm of Death, 140/120/100s. The blind does nothing to his abilities — save Vault to break Death's Grasp.

edits.before: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: matchup-defining — His 1v1 realm. Survive it with MR. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Realm of Death, 140/120/100s: his 1v1 realm. Survive it with MR. - Death's Grasp, 16s at rank 1: his only engage — Vault after it lands, never before. - Indestructible, 12s: anti-heal it. - Your ultimate: roam tempo.

edits.before: This is his window and you have to play it honest. At 6 his Realm of Death (R) is built to erase a kiter like you — it pulls you into a sealed 1v1, steals your AD/AP, and your whole identity is movement and range that the realm cancels. Never walk up when his R is up and your E is on cooldown. Use your own R as a roam/tempo tool instead: shove the wave, scout, and make plays bot or mid so the game isn't a string of even-statless duels. Bait his E pull, sidestep, and only commit when you can blink the return over him.
edits.after: This is his window and you have to play it honest. At 6 Realm of Death is built to erase a kiter like you — a sealed 1v1 that steals your AD and AP while your whole identity is the range the realm cancels. Never walk up with his R up and Vault down. Indestructible returns every 12/11/10/9/8s and heals back exactly the chip you deal, so Executioner's Calling early is not optional. Use your own R as roam tempo: shove, scout, make plays elsewhere. Bait Death's Grasp, sidestep it, and commit only after it.

notes: FLAG MISFIRE: the kit file tags Mordekaiser's Obliterate (Q) with grounding: 'shuts off enemy dashes'. Riot's own description for Obliterate says only that he smashes the ground for damage, increased against a single target — no grounding clause. Per the trust-the-description rule I did NOT write any Vault-denial claim into either layer, and it stays out of unverified-as-fact. If someone can confirm Morde grounds, Vault denial would be the single most important line in this matchup and should be added then.
